description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance scores for different models: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, and ClnGS (w/). The horizontal axis displays the model names in the order Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, and ClnGS (w/), with no apparent sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “Average Performance,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Four individual bars are present, each representing a model’s average performance. The “Standard” model is represented by an orange bar extending to approximately 52. The “Self-RAG” model is represented by a light green bar reaching a height of approximately 52. The “FactTune” model is represented by a green bar extending to approximately 50. Finally, the “ClnGS (w/)" model is represented by a blue bar reaching a height of approximately 58. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
